scientific_choices.choice: Reuse all frozen 1233-image GPU TEST detector boxes, direct PARSeq readings and care/ignore annotations. Preserve exact casefold plus punctuation/symbol removal, spaces, bbox IoU0.5 and one-to-one matching.

Explore the same scalar threshold grid for raw detector confidence and existing joint confidence with same-reading NMS. No new crops, model inference, retraining, geometry changes or ignore-policy changes.

Select exploratory per-dataset maxima by Hmean, then correct count, then lower threshold. Also seek one shared joint threshold improving all three baselines; maximize the smallest absolute Hmean gain, breaking ties by average gain then lower threshold. This uses TEST labels and cannot establish final generalization or change the frozen deployment setting.

For fixed deterministic descending joint-score NMS, filtering its survivors at a higher score is identical to applying the same score threshold before NMS. Verify baseline candidate IDs and focused equivalence tests.

CTW1500 failure analysis partitions full-line GT by normalized whitespace tokens; proper contiguous token fragments count only if at least half the predicted box lies within the GT axis bbox. GT affects diagnostics only, never prediction selection.

The qualified PARSeq config uses the 94-character training vocabulary without whitespace and max label length25. Preserve the existing whitespace-sensitive metric and report its incompatibility with multiword line annotations.
Detector floors below0.05, changed YOLO proposal NMS, line grouping, official polygon/ignore protocol and independent validation of TEST-selected thresholds are separate experiments.
